intent: Cross the brightest June morning, a flower valley and sunlit climb to a huge midsummer plateau and golden-evening horizon.

sections.name: The midsummer morning
sections.lesson: Begin beneath the longest day’s sky

signs.text:
The midsummer morning

sections.name: The flower valley
sections.lesson: Follow the wide valley’s bellflower arcs

signs.text:
The flower valley
Follow the wide valley’s bellflower arcs

sections.name: The sunlit hill
sections.lesson: Climb from flowers into the long light

signs.text:
The sunlit hill

sections.name: The midsummer plateau
sections.lesson: A broad high crossing under an enormous sky

signs.text:
The midsummer plateau
A broad high crossing under an enormous sky

sections.name: The golden-evening horizon
sections.lesson: Keep moving into the warm evening light
